column1: # The validator is a structural check (balanced parens, terminated classes,
# defined escapes, and a quantifier after every atom), so it accepts ECMA-262
# patterns RE2 rejects and rejects only structurally malformed patterns. The official suite holds three string cases
# against this format: a valid pattern and an unbalanced parenthesis in
# which suite_test.go skips under reasonAnnexBIdentity as a documented
# divergence. These rows write down the class boundary all three leave open.
# Row format: see loadVectorFile in vectors_test.go.

column1: # ECMA-262 22.2.1 derives Term from Atom Quantifier, so a quantifier with no

# braced quantifier form as an ExtendedPatternCharacter literal.
